snippet.title: Menherarium Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
"Let’s play together… forever, okay?"
Menherarium is a deck-building roguelite where you must survive 7 days of blood-staked Chinchiro against a super clingy, menhera girl.
Trapped by a menhera girl, you’re forced to gamble your blood each day in a twisted dice game.
Tweak your dice, use cheat items, and overcome her selfish, ever-changing rules to survive the week.

Twitter→ https://x.com/TezcatlipocaLab
Steam→ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3394770/_/
